title: A run that failed inside an HTTP 200 is an error, not an empty success
rationale: The Responses API accepts a request and then reports the run's own failure in the body. Reading that as an empty successful reply is how a failed turn arrives looking finished -- and on the synchronous path it is also what hides the failure from the fallback coordinator, which watches core.error and never llm.response.

error.message: the model failed to generate a response
